import pandas as pd

from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor

df = pd.read_csv("data/smd_process_log.csv").dropna(subset=["Tact_Time", "Placement_Force", "Reflow_Peak_Temp", "Machine"])

X = pd.get_dummies(df[["Placement_Force", "Reflow_Peak_Temp", "Machine"]], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
X["const"] = 1.0
vif_data = pd.DataFrame({
    "Feature": X.columns,
    "VIF": [variance_inflation_factor(X.values, i).round(2) for i in range(len(X.columns))]
})

print("=== 1. OLS 회귀계수 요약 (p-value < 0.05 검토) ===")
print(model.params.round(4))

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

df = pd.read_csv("data/smd_process_log.csv").dropna()
X = df[["Offset_X", "Placement_Force"]]
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

# K=2, 3, 4 실루엣 점수 비교 (군집 품질 평가)
scores = {}
for k in [2, 3, 4]:
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10).fit(X_scaled)
    score = silhouette_score(X_scaled, km.labels_)
    scores[f"K={k} 군집"] = round(score, 4)

print("=== K값별 실루엣 계수(Silhouette Score, 높을수록 우수) ===")
for k_label, s_val in scores.items():
    print(f"{k_label}: {s_val}")

best_k = 3
km_best = KMeans(n_clusters=best_k, random_state=42, n_init=10).fit(X_scaled)
df_clustered = df[["Offset_X", "Placement_Force"]].copy()
df_clustered["Cluster"] = km_best.labels_
print(f"\n=== K={best_k} 군집별 평균 센서 특성 ===")
print(df_clustered.groupby("Cluster").mean().round(2))

import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv("data/smd_process_log.csv").dropna()

# 1. Two-sample T-test (Welch: SMD_Line_A vs SMD_Line_B 간 Offset_X 평균 차이)
line_a = df[df["Line"] == "SMD_Line_A"]["Offset_X"]
line_b = df[df["Line"] == "SMD_Line_B"]["Offset_X"]
t_stat, p_val_t = stats.ttest_ind(line_a, line_b, equal_var=False)

# 2. One-Way ANOVA (Mounter 4개 설비 간 Reflow_Peak_Temp 차이 검정)
m1 = df[df["Machine"] == "Mounter_01"]["Reflow_Peak_Temp"]
m2 = df[df["Machine"] == "Mounter_02"]["Reflow_Peak_Temp"]
m3 = df[df["Machine"] == "Mounter_03"]["Reflow_Peak_Temp"]
m4 = df[df["Machine"] == "Mounter_04"]["Reflow_Peak_Temp"]
f_stat, p_val_f = stats.f_oneway(m1, m2, m3, m4)

# 3. Chi-Square (설비 종류와 불량 발생 여부의 독립성 검정)
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df["Machine"], df["Is_Defective"])
chi2, p_val_chi2, dof, _ = stats.chi2_contingency(cross_tab, correction=False)

print("=== 📊 공정 통계 가설검정 요약 리포트 (유의수준 a = 0.05) ===")
print("1. 독립표본 T-test (Line A vs B 장착 오차): t=%.3f, p-value=%.5f -> %s" % (t_stat, p_val_t, "유의한 차이 있음 (귀무 기각)" if p_val_t < 0.05 else "차이 없음 (귀무 채택)"))
print("2. 일원배치 ANOVA (설비 4종 간 피크온도): F=%.3f, p-value=%.5f -> %s" % (f_stat, p_val_f, "설비별 유의한 차이 있음 (귀무 기각)" if p_val_f < 0.05 else "설비 간 동일함 (귀무 채택)"))
print("3. 카이제곱 검정 (설비와 불량의 연관성): chi2=%.3f, p-value=%.5f -> %s" % (chi2, p_val_chi2, "강한 연관성 존재 (귀무 기각)" if p_val_chi2 < 0.05 else "서로 독립적임 (귀무 채택)"))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv("data/smd_process_log.csv").dropna()
offset_sample = df["Offset_X"].sample(50, random_state=42)

n = len(offset_sample)
mean = offset_sample.mean()
s = offset_sample.std(ddof=1) # 표본 표준편차 (ddof=1 필수!)

# 95% 신뢰수준 (양측 검정이므로 1 - 0.05/2 = 0.975)
t_val = stats.t.ppf(0.975, df=n-1)
margin = t_val * (s / np.sqrt(n))

ci_lower = mean - margin
ci_upper = mean + margin

print("=== 표본 크기 n=%d SMD 마운트 오차 모평균 95%% 신뢰구간 추정 ===" % n)
print("1. 표본평균 (Mean): %.3f um" % mean)
print("2. 표본표준편차 (s): %.3f um" % s)
print("3. t 임계값 t(0.025, df=%d): %.4f" % (n-1, t_val))
print("4. 표본오차 (Margin of Error): ±%.3f um" % margin)
print("5. 95%% 모평균 신뢰구간: [%.3f um, %.3f um]" % (ci_lower, ci_upper))
